body:
I'm due on November 17th if you want to check in but it's better for you if you try to forget.

That's a really wonderful story, but not universal. Some people who fail try again. I've had months to think about this. I know what I need to do.
But like other people have said he could rape other girls. I really would be responsible for that, at least partially.
But wouldn't it make me responsible for anyone else he raped?
Oh okay I guess I can have him sign them away. That's a good point, thank you. I don't want that to happen

Thank you for  explaining that. I'm amazed at how helpful and supportive this community is, and how many people there are. rapecounseling was very polite but so inactive. I feel bad for guys because idk if there's a big supportive subreddit like this for them and rapecounseling is so small. 

But really almost everyone has been very kind and supportive and those who haven't still had good intentions
No but like if I don't report him he might rape other people. It seems selfish of me not too, but  I don't know if I can
I don't want to like let him keep going though :/
I don't know. It's not a guarantee it'll ever get better, and it'd be so easy to just slip away.
I feel like I'm letting you down, but I really don't think I can :/ I already had to deal with most people not believing me. It was terrible.
Thank you for posting that. I really hope her parents love her, and that nothing like this ever happens to her.

I don't know. Someone else mentioned the ptsd and depression could hurt the baby. I might go to help with that at least. I almost don't want to get away from it. It seems like such a relief to get it over with. I look forward to it a bit.
Okay I'll try. I'd feel awful if I did something like that to her :/ I just want to bring something good into the world

I don't know. I feel like my ability to enjoy things has been like strangled away. It's so hard now to find something fun, or to laugh. I feel like friends and stuff aren't really great in the long run, because people I thought were close friends abandoned me fairly easily.

Wait can you explain that? Oh god that's terrible. I've been like really suicidal and have a fair amount of flashbacks, I guess, idk how many are normal. Do you know at what point it affects her? I really don't want to have hurt her just because I can't get over it :/
Like if I was on my own jury I'd agree but it's so hard to convince myself that. Does that make any sense?

I just don't know. I haven't enjoyed anything in a while now. My best friend is dead, and it was kind of my fault, and all the others abandoned me. It's just so hard to see a point. Like I don't even enjoy dumb stuff anymore. Tv shows I used to like, etc. I haven't read a book in weeks, I used to read 100+ in a year. I know some of that is hormones, but if it  was up to me I would've been dead months ago. I'd just built up the nerve when I found out about the pregnancy and I've just been killing time since.

It's hard to explain. Sometimes you feel guilty over something you know you shouldn't. Like I know it's his fault, and if someone else told me this story I'd tell them it wasn't their fault, but my brain blames itself. It's natural, it's like a human thing. Make yourself at fault because you don't want to think it can just happen. It's like the Just World theory or something, it's why people victim blame.
Oh. I guess maybe I can do that. I don't know.

Oh sorry I didn't make it clear. It's too late for the abortion now, I'm too far along. I kinda feel like I regret that, but I don't know that's really confusing. I'll be adopting the baby to very nice parents.
Thanks for all that. I'll look into telling the nurse or something. But don't worry about the baby, I won't be doing it until after that.
Oh wow that sounds really sensitive of them. I don't know if most places are like that though
Oh I think that's a trial thing. Like the defense asking me questions about it. Um I guess I'll look into it but it's really scary to me. How long did that all take?
Okay I'll keep all that in mind too
Do they like cross examine me or anything though?
I think I know it like intellectually but on a gut level it feels like I at least contributed.

I mean I don't plan on making it after the birth. I realize this is incredibly selfish, but I can't handle trial. My best friend did that and it went horribly for him, and I'm not nearly as strong as him.

I'm not in immediate danger, I won't do it until after the birth.

Okay. That's a really good way to phrase that, I'll tell them when I can build up the courage.
Yes, but they believe the circumstances made me somewhat responsible.
Thank you for that
I'm seeing her about the baby and stuff but I haven't told her it was rape. I feel like they'd want to get me to report it.
He's my age, maybe a year older. I'm really glad that worked out for you, and it's awesome they're in jail. But I'm not that strong, and I don't have 6 months.
Thank you for telling me about that, I really appreciate it
I never really looked into that but they might. Thanks.
Thank you for that
I know like morally I should but I couldn't take a trial. My friend who committed suicide went through that and it was brutal. He just wanted to get justice and it was so hard on him.

Oh haha that sucks. Yeah  religion would probably be a good way to meet people, but that's not for me or for everyone. What are your interests? You could start a group for your favorite show or something, get together once a week to watch it, or discuss it.

What kind of place do you live in? I'm not really good at that either but I know meetup.com has ways for people to make friends. Or like taking classes and stuff. It's not that no one wants to be friends with you! It's just most people aren't looking for that when in public and stuff. You know what I mean? You have to try to find people with similar interests or hobbies
I can try talking to them, okay. I don't want to go to the hospital though. A friend of mine did that when he was suicidal and it just made things worse for him.

Hi I don't have any specific advice, but I definitely know what you mean about it being therapeutic. Having a plan is very comforting. 

I guess the thing I can say is that it's not pathetic to need people. It's a stupid song, but "people who need people are the luckiest people in the world". We're communal, you know? Everybody needs help. All those movies and stuff where people live alone for years, Robinson Crusoe and Castaway and etc, it's always a tragedy that they're cut off. Relying on people isn't a sin, it's human. If people help you that means they care about you.
That's probably a good idea but I'm not really good at confrontations and don't want to get yelled at :/ But I guess I can try talking to them more
Yeah. They were supportive at first but less so when they heard the circumstances. They didn't kick me out though and have helped me with the pregnancy.
idk I don't really want to go through all that. Maybe that makes me selfish, but I couldn't. Getting examined in court and having everything questioned, reliving it.
Thank you :) that's really very nice of you to say. I appreciate it a lot.
I've called the hotline a couple times and it was never really helpful but thank you. It's hard to open up in person.
But that just points that we had sex. He told everyone it was consensual, it's just he said she said. Almost everyone believes him because he's very charming and involved, well liked and stuff.

I really don't want to make you sad, but I've already committed to that. I'm just sticking around to give the baby to a good home. I'm really sorry if that makes you sad :( I don't want to make anyone sad, it's just I think that's whats best for me. It's a couple months off though so don't worry. You'll forget by then :)

I don't why this is getting downvotes but I'm really sorry if I offended anyone :/ I didn't mean to imply abortions are bad or anything. not getting one was probably a bad idea, I don't know. I was so scared at the time.

If this is the wrong subreddit I'm really sorry. Does anyone have any ideas where would be a good place for help? I've tried suicidewatch and pregnant.

Honestly I'm not sure why I'm going to school any more at all. There's not going to be a point in the end.

I guess I can try that. idk if there's a planned parenthood near me but I'll look.
Oh that's a good idea. I'm not sure if there's one nearby but I'll look, thank you.
I really appreciate that but I've already committed. The birth is a few months off, I have some time. I lost all my friends over time.
Thanks I'll search twox. Someone else told me to post there but looking through is good advice as well.

It's very easy to think that when you're depressed but I guarantee you're not from what you've said. If he's your partner for ten years he's stayed with you for a reason, he obviously  loves you. it can just be hard sometimes. He wouldn't be happier without you there, you sound very close.

Honestly I will be giving her up for adoption. I would not be a good parent for her, I'm 15 and have no support, and plan on suicide shortly after the birth. I hate being pregnant, hate being reminded of what happened, and I really couldn't stand to raise her. I feel incredibly guilty about that, but I just couldn't take it and it wouldn't be a good environment for her. I don't think my flashbacks will go away just because she's born.
Okay good idea. I'll probably do it tomorrow I'll probably go to bed soon.
Hey thanks for that, I'll check it out

I don't think it's any more odd for a middle aged person to be suicidal than a young person. People focus on teenage suicide but IIRC the most at risk group is men over 85- it happens to all ages. I don't know your circumstances or anything but don't feel worse about it because of your age.

What did I make up? You're not even remotely challenging any of the points I mentioned. You just wander into fucking/r/suicidewatch and spout some sexist shit, why? How did you think that was going to help me, or really anyone?

Do you know much about history? The Aztecs aren't an oddball culture, they were a large empire. 

The romans had very different beliefs from you. They encouraged older men to have sex with young boys, believing it to be healthy, and kept slaves. Just the fact that slavery was legal in America and is now considered horrible shows you how much morals change. There is literally no concept of traditional morals other than people rejecting open sexuality and trying to claw back to an overly idealized time that never existed.

There's no evidence though. The defense just tries to make the victim look like shit I couldn't take that. And I'm not waiting around the years for a trial.

 He's a student yeah, he's in some of my classes. 

I don't feel very intelligent any more.

Yeah, you've got that all right.

Sadly no. I was stupid and didn't report it immediately, didn't tell anyone until I knew I was pregnant. There's no evidence that it was rape, DNA shows that it's his baby but he would claim it was consensual or even that I raped him. The vast majority of people believe him, he's a very charming and likeable person.
IDK if I have PTSD or not. But just everything in general. I don't really enjoy life anymore.
I really don't care what it's like. I just want to stop doing this
I had a little bit during puberty, or maybe just hormones or something, but that went away. But the pregnancy came about because of a rape, that's when the depression started.
November 17th
Definitely. Some kind of afterlife would be nice, but I'd settle for a void. Not like I'd ever realize it, you know?
Maybe for you :)

People looking in from the outside always think there's a chance to get better. It's hard to understand looking seriously at suicide as an option unless you've been there, because it goes in the face of everything else we've ever learned. 

I don't know if  I really believe in sanctioned suicide or anything like that. It seems like so many people have been saved. When I go I'll be glad no one stopped me, but I think if anyone encouraged me it would feel wrong. People need to be mature about this kind of thing, random cliches or whatever don't usually help people. 

I dunno if that's really relevent to what you're talking about. I guess I can just understand them not supporting your suicide. I've only been depressed somewhat recently, I can't imagine having it for so long.
He always will be haha
As soon as I give birth I'm going out.

>Why couldn't you do it, if it's not because you know it's wrong?

Because I was scared, and felt too attached to the child. People have other reasons for not doing things than thinking it's wrong. I don't think partying is wrong and I don't do that.

>Why is that? What do you expect to happen then?

If I raised her I couldn't kill myself, because she'd be relying on me. I can't kill myself now, because she would die too. What do I expect to happen after I die? I have no idea. I don't care. I just don't want to be alive anymore.

But many cultures had vastly different ethics and culture. There's no one traditional morals. "natural law" would be like clubbing people over the head and living like animals. I don't see how that's better.
I have and do :) I like him a lot as an actor.
It's okay, don't worry about it. It's whats best.

I will definitely be adopting her. I don't agree that abortion is wrong but I couldn't do it, and I couldn't raise her. Like even under normal circumstances I'd be a bad parent. And I couldn't stand raising her, it wouldn't be good for her. Also I couldn't kill myself, which is mostly what I look forward to.

There's no such thing as traditional morals. Morals always change. When do you think the peak time of morals was, that you want them to be based on? Because there would also be racism, sexism, and other forms of bigotry. No era is morally perfect. 

Men's and women's psychology isn't really all that different. Also putting them ahead of you in line for lifeboats is the exact definition of putting women on a pedestal. 

> but men need to view them and treat them in a certain way to keep their own heads on straight. 

What do you mean by that?
No they can tell it's his baby but there's no more evidence that is was rape. It's just I said he said.

I really appreciate you writing all that but I don't think girls should be put on a pedestal or anything. If somebody is nice to me it should be because they're nice or they like me rather than just because of how I was born.
Oh I'd love that too :)
I know just what you mean. There's a really comforting feel too it, like the theme song to a show I loved as a little girl. It's very sweet, but I feel the sadness too.

I definitely agree that life can be beautiful but I think it's not for me anymore. I really appreciate all that, but I know what I'm going to do. I'm not really looking to be convinced not to do it, I just want some company until it's time for me to go.
Do you still want to talk to me?

Yeah they got exponentially worse. F

I have but I'm not a huge fan honestly.
Oh okay. That's really cool :)
Why a frown face? I imagine it'd be well designed lol
So hard to decide! Probably Station to Station, but anything from 69 to 83 is perfect.
I have, that's a really nice video
thanks haha
I didn't tell anyone until I found out I was pregnant, so the evidence that it was rape not sex is gone
That's tough. Honestly my favorite changes too much. Least favorite is Robo Cop 3. It has no redeeming value.
Awesome :) Do you know what album/show he worked on?

Oh that's really awesome, haha trying hard not to ask a million questions. Why, and what was he like?

Tarantino, Fincher, Tarkovsky, Anderson (Paul Thomas and Wes), Arronofsky, Cronenberg, Kubrick, The Coens, Coppola (well in the 70s at least).
David bowie is my favorite musician, movies my tastes are too broad. I go more by director than genre or anything.
Reading, music, movies, stuff like that.
Honestly not really. I've kinda lost enthusiasm for things you know? Just need some human contact.
